title: Return to November 5 for documentary filming
place_text: Orman Road near November 5 site, New Underwood, South Dakota

tellings.quote: of that vehicle and walked toward that site man that feeling came over me I about went to my knees

plain: Mario Woods, a former guard at US nuclear missile sites who says he was abducted by a UFO on a November 5 long ago, returned in the 2020s to the spot on Orman Road near New Underwood, South Dakota, to film a documentary. Woods says that as he got out of the vehicle and walked toward the site, "that feeling came over me, I about went to my knees." He tells it as his own experience, a sign of how strongly the place still affects him.
